scope: 32-entry bounded thermal conductivity memoization; private experiments only

1.scope: 96x96 native frame fixtures, not whole-game FPS
1.timing: Process CPU includes worker/orchestration; wall includes readiness polling. Snapshots excluded.
1.decision: V1 not adopted: thermal median CPU reduction is 9.205 percent, below the predeclared 10 percent threshold. Mixed scenes are within the 3 percent median regression limit. Raw timing variation remains substantial. A separately measured V2 will move MXCSR capture out of each pair.

2.scope: 96x96 native frame fixtures, not whole-game FPS
